name: selective-ink-sketch
title_zh: 把照片变成有留白的钢笔速写
tagline_zh: 上传一张照片，得到一幅刻意省略的钢笔速写。不是滤镜，是观察式取舍，线条密度与负空间都为你重排。
tagline_en: Turn a photo into a deliberate pen-and-ink sketch with real omissions, not filters—density and negative space.
desc_en: Turn a user-uploaded photograph into an original monochrome observational pen-and-ink sketch through deliberate omission, negative space, density control, and source fidelity. Use when the user asks for 钢笔速写, 建筑速写, 风景速写, 人物速写, 肖像速写, photo-to-ink sketch, architectural sketch, landscape sketch, figure sketch, portrait sketch, or wants an attached JPG/PNG/WebP photo redrawn with selective hand-drawn
why_zh: 它模拟画家的观察决策：先定主体，再逐层省略，密度控制由源图引导，保真而非乱真。
why_en: It mimics an artist's eye: decides what to omit, then rebuilds density from the source—fidelity over mimicry.
limit_zh: 仅处理单张上传的 JPG/PNG/WebP 照片；不适用于多图合成、非写实风格或需保留色彩的场合。输出为黑白线稿。
limit_en: Single uploaded JPG/PNG/WebP only; no multi-image, color, or non-realistic styles. Output is monochrome line art—beyond that, it degrades.
